doc: How sxs/policy/decide.py chooses on popups and cards. Rules are tried in order; the first whose 'when' holds and whose 'match' regex finds the card's title or body wins. 'choose' is a regex for the button to press, or 'dismiss' (back arrow or tap outside), or 'cancel' (the dialog's Cancel button). Goals: explore (finish the current Explore quest), daily (daily loop), idle (just get home). Add a rule whenever a new card shows up; anything no rule covers is dismissed and logged as unknown. A dismiss taps outside the card unless the rule says "dismiss_by": "back" (the bottom-left back arrow) or "below" (under the card, 360, 1120).
never_doc: Buttons never pressed by any card rule (mae: no spending, no pulls outside sxs.loops.pray --handler-approved, no class or guild choices). 'buttons' still lists some spend words so they are read as buttons, not as the card's title; this list is what keeps them untapped.

rules.why: A paid pack popup (seen 2026-11-10: 'Exploration Kit', $0.99, opened by a walk tap on the Timed Packs HUD button). Never buy (R-043, R-126); a tap above the card doesn't close it, a tap below it (360, 1120) does.

Team-up, party and friend requests from other players: accept (mae, 2026-11-05, R-057: teaming up is an important part of the game). Typing in chat and guild create/choose/leave stay off-limits; the never-list still blocks any spend button.

A blocker that only an item clears: Boulder Blockade (Magic Drill, R-151), Vine Blockade, Sealing Pillar (live 2026-11-11, Rabbit Vault: needs a Gateway Key, a 'Clearing Item' sold in the Verdantglade Kingdom Shop; we own 0). Never buy it (shop purchases wait for mae's Buy? marks). Clear Zone ends blocked_item and marks the zone blocked.
Fallback when the request card has no accept button we know: leave it.
Lost a fight. OK goes home; Cancel would leave the character stranded at 0 HP.
The tracked quest's Go button wants to travel home to reach its content (e.g. the Fantasia Ascent tower). Travel only, nothing spent.

Once power reaches the gate's number the card shows 'Power reaches 15.5K (Current: 16.9K)' and a free Open button (seen 2026-11-04, docs/screens/world/gate_of_power_open.png). Without the button, the next rule treats it as a wall.
A stone pillar that only moves once power reaches the number on the card (Damp Woods: 15.5K). Nothing to press; it's a wall until we're stronger.

Shown after a LOST fight (mae, 2026-11-04: a dead run; in a mini-dungeon progress resets). Quick Heal eats cooked dishes (Green Riceball), not premium currency, so the character can try again; the loop counts it as a loss for the retry rule.
Low HP and nothing to do out here: go home.
Quest detail from the tracker: Go travels to the quest, Track turns tracking on.
Not working on quests right now.
Travel prompts from the quest tracker; free.
Not travelling when the goal is just to get home.
Activating a portal is free, counts toward exploration and unlocks fast travel.
Live 2026-11-09 (Verdantglade V, Statue of Lunar Sage): Visit is free, gives a permanent stat boost (HP +170), heals fully and counts toward exploration.

Live 2026-11-10: the gate between Verdantglade V and VI opens free once its requirement is met (Reach the Apprentice II rank). With the requirement unmet there is no Unlock button and the card is dismissed. Opening it started Explore Verdantglade VI (0 -> 3%).

Live 2026-11-10 (Verdantglade VI): a gear card ('Beasthide Armor+21') opened during a fog walk; a tap above it landed on the Character screen behind and opened the Class page. Back out instead; gear choices belong to gearswap.
Live 2026-11-10: the Class page's class card showed up mid-walk after a stray tap. Never change class (policy); back out.

rules.match: Wheel of Destiny|All items have an equal drop rate
rules.why: Live 2026-11-10 (Jungle Camp's Lucky Wheel): 'Tap to spin' uses Lucky Wheel tickets (we have 0); never spin unasked. A tap outside doesn't close this full screen: use the back arrow.
Live 2026-11-10 (Damp Woods): a structure opens a Rankings board. Nothing to do there while exploring; back out, press nothing.
The Voyage Obelisk is the gate to the next kingdom (Originisle V → Verdantglade); the quest marker points at it, and activating it is free.
A Goddess Statue that is already unlocked ('A starlit statue silently guards this Blessed Land', Regional Relics, no button): nothing to do; close it and walk around it.
Unlocking a Goddess Statue once the area is 100% explored blesses the land (+1 Blessing Level, which feeds the Bed's AFK EXP). Free; it's the follow-up quest 'The Goddess's Grace'.

A monster group's card on the map (seen 2026-11-10: 'Limpid Legion', Rcmd Power 28.5K, Current Power 28.5K, Drop Preview, Challenge). Free; fight it when our power is within the 1.25x rule (fights.py) and HP is fine: clearing monsters counts toward Explore quests.
A monster group too strong for us (beyond the 1.25x rule), HP low, or not exploring: leave it.
Structures on the map are mini-dungeons with floors of fights; clearing them counts toward Explore quests.
Skip mini-dungeons when not exploring or when HP is low.
Floor cleared; keep climbing. Low HP isn't a reason to leave a mini-dungeon (mae, 2026-11-04): heal mid-run (the wounded dialog's Quick Heal, or the profile) and go on.
